Cytoband.description: A single nuclear cytogenetic band, without a range or location descriptor.

LocusGroup.description: HGNC locus group, separate from a missing source value.

Text.description: Bounded nonempty text with surrounding Unicode whitespace removed.

VariantRegion.description: Primary-chromosome region. The parser additionally requires the end to be at least the start.

description: Search genes by text, cytoband, or their intersection, with ClinGen dosage regions that match.

band.description: A cytoband prefix. Also lists ClinGen dosage regions in that band.

locus_group.description:
Optional HGNC locus group intersected with the selector; help search gene
Optional HGNC locus group intersected with the selector.

query.description:
Words matched against symbols, previous symbols, aliases and names;
a ClinGen ISCA ID, such as ISCA-37400, returns that region.

region.description:
A GRCh38 interval, such as chr16:29600000-30200000. Selects ClinGen dosage regions that
overlap it; HGNC genes carry no coordinates, so it adds no genes.

title: GeneSearch
